project.name: Society Maintenance Tracker
project.description: Greenfield FastAPI backend for apartment-society complaint management: residents file complaints (with photos), admins manage categories, priorities, status lifecycle, notices, dashboard stats, and overdue tracking.

items: postgres host port 5433 (5432 occupied by unrelated container backend-db-1); inside compose network db:5432
dedicated test database smt_test on same server, created/dropped by tests/conftest.py
lifecycle OPEN->IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED, OPEN->RESOLVED ALLOWED (requires admin note)
RESOLVED is immutable; no reopen mechanism

overdue is dynamic: status != RESOLVED AND now(UTC) > created_at + threshold_days; threshold stored in system_settings table key 'overdue_threshold_days', default 3 from env OVERDUE_THRESHOLD_DAYS, range 1..365, admin-editable
admin listing order: overdue first, then priority HIGH > LOW, then newest first
notices order: is_important desc, created_at desc
emails dispatched post-commit as background tasks; failure logged, never corrupts transaction; EMAIL_ENABLED=false logs instead of sending
important notice email sent only on notice CREATION (not on later toggles of is_important)
priority changes do NOT create history entries; history records status changes only
pagination envelope {total, limit, offset, items}; error shape {detail, code}
UUID primary keys via SQLAlchemy Uuid type; UTC timezone-aware timestamps; ISO 8601 serialization

photo upload: StorageService abstraction, local implementation under uploads/complaints/, UUID filenames, MIME whitelist image/jpeg|png|webp + extension check + size cap MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB (default 5MB); DB stores path reference only
login accepts JSON {email,password}; Swagger Authorize uses OAuth2PasswordBearer tokenUrl /api/v1/auth/login
resident sees own complaints only; foreign complaint returns 404 (not 403)
categories soft-deleted via is_active=false when referenced by complaints

rules: complaint creation inserts initial OPEN row

services.auth_service: Registration, login with argon2 verification, JWT issue/verify, current-user resolution.
services.complaint_service: CRUD for complaints, photo attachment, filtering/sorting/pagination, admin ordering, status/priority transitions with history recording and immutability checks.
services.notice_service: CRUD for notices with importance ordering and creation-time email trigger.
services.notification_service: Email dispatch as post-commit background tasks; no-op logging when EMAIL_ENABLED=false.
services.storage_service: Abstraction over file storage; local impl saves uploads/complaints/ with UUID filenames, MIME/extension whitelist and size cap.
services.dashboard_service: Aggregated summary counts/stats for the admin dashboard.
services.overdue_service: Dynamic overdue computation against overdue_threshold_days setting from system_settings.
services.settings_service: Read/write key-value rows in system_settings incl. validation of overdue threshold range 1..365.

routes.purpose: JSON login, returns JWT bearer token
Create complaint (multipart form with optional photo)
List complaints; filters: category_id,status,priority,date_from,date_to,overdue,limit,offset,sort; resident sees own only
Get single complaint (404 if foreign for resident)
Transition status per lifecycle; OPEN->RESOLVED requires admin note; RESOLVED immutable; writes history
List notices ordered is_important desc, created_at desc
Create notice (admin); email blast if important
Update notice (admin); toggling importance sends no email
